description: This is a Python source file implementing an AI chatbot with speech recognition, synthesis, and conversation management using Pipecat framework components, Google services, and custom transport handlers.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context for the language model conversation, including system messages.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with the context for managing conversation state.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the chatbot pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline, such as metrics and timeouts.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including starting and canceling.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running the language model within the pipeline.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the chatbot pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the chatbot, initializes transport and starts the bot.
